notes: Long entry; water system (Site 171), Lower Sartaba (Site 172) and siege works (Site 165) are referred to other entries not in the packet. f1: data block 'Cisterns: 14'; fig. 339 shows a group labelled 'Cisterns' on the eastern slope, but the unit point (100 m E of the entry's central grid 1937/1670, 100-m precision) cannot be placed on that ~250 m plan, so 'none'. f2/f3: the excavation (and the peristyle) is 'in the east side of the site' / on the eastern slope ~50 m below the tip of the cone; pool coded 'east part'; cistern 'none' because a part-of-site location is not a direction for a pit. f4: robbing pits in the northern area of the summit (also Zschokke's 'Vertiefungen' and the British Survey's 'two excavations or pits', which the entry links to them) - within-site location, so 'none'. f5: measured on Abel's plan fig. 335 (north arrow points page-right, ~6.6 deg below horizontal; bar 0-400 m): unit point placed on the drawn summit oval 'acropole ou Qarn Sartabeh' (the 100-m point precision is small at this scale); 'citerne' label centre ~274 deg, ~615 m (if taken at the end of the aqueduct line, ~264 deg, ~680 m). It lies on the plateau = lower Sartaba, i.e. probably at WBADB S1295. f6 is a historical burial record, no location given; tomb type not stated, so cavity_with_opening false. f7 is hearsay reported to Robinson, location 'somewhere on Surtabeh'. Not coded: moat/ditch, robbing trench SW of the southern structure (an excavation, not a pit), aqueduct, quarried steps.
